title: Scheme Tor from the actual derived tensor and canonical resolution maps
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal O_X$-modules $P,M$, define $T_q(P,M)=H^{-q}(P[0]\otimes^{\mathrm L}M[0])$ for $q\in\mathbf N$, using the actual derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Its maps are the homology of tensor products of degree-zero maps. For a short exact sequence in either variable, its connecting maps are those of the signed derived tensor triangle. For a specified K-flat complex $E$ augmented quasi-isomorphically to $P[0]$, the canonical derived comparison identifies this tensor with the localization of the termwise tensor complex $E\otimes M$, and induces its homology comparison, using the existing sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. On an open $U$, use the section modules and the recorded ring Tor [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]; its augmented projective-resolution comparison is the canonical left-derived-functor comparison.
